mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.beacon_id, a.beacon_type, a.control_type, a.location, a.map_coord, a.gps_coord, a.beacon_status, a.deploy_status, a.create_by, a.create_date, a.update_by, a.update_date, a.remarks FROM swm_beacon_station a WHERE a.beacon_id = #{beaconId} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id, a.beacon_id, a.beacon_type, a.control_type, a.location, a.map_coord, a.gps_coord, a.beacon_status, a.deploy_status, a.create_by, a.create_date, a.update_by, a.update_date, a.remarks FROM swm_beacon_station a WHERE a.location LIKE CONCAT('%', #{location}, '%') ORDER BY a.update_date DESC

SELECT a.id, a.beacon_id, a.beacon_type, a.control_type, a.location, a.map_coord, a.gps_coord, a.beacon_status, a.deploy_status, a.create_by, a.create_date, a.update_by, a.update_date, a.remarks FROM swm_beacon_station a WHERE a.beacon_status = '1' AND a.status = '0' ORDER BY a.update_date DESC
